correctness.rationale: Exact independent full-face predicates, 6812-face acyclic matched Hasse certificate, integer Morse differentials d5 and d6 with determinantal divisors (1) and (1,1,1,0), and cellular degree cancellations reconstruct wedge^3 S^6. Independently computed original GF(2) boundary ranks agree. All 96 graph automorphisms and Lefschetz traces obtained in two distinct ways; squared character norm 1 and exactly two kernel elements. Verification uses included actual source/output and no numerical approximation.

value.rationale: GP(8,3) is the canonical 16-vertex cubic symmetric Levi graph of the (8_3) configuration; parameter two is the natural first higher-independence case and lies outside the published explicit graph families. The exact integral homotopy classification, absolute irreducibility under all 96 automorphisms, central kernel and rational quotient consequence are structural invariants not implied by the ordinary independence complex, homology dimensions or the existing graph-family bounds. A motivated finite exact classification, not an arbitrary numerical slice.
